description:
Turn your lecture notes, PDFs, slides, and course documents into an active study system with Kuliko AI—right inside your conversation.

Create the learning resources you need:
- Flashcards for focused memorization
- Quizzes and practice questions for exam prep
- Clear summaries for fast review
- Mind maps that connect key concepts
- Cornell-style notes with cues and takeaways

Study with active recall and spaced repetition, review the flashcards that are due, take interactive quizzes, search your source material, and focus on the topics that need more practice.

Whether you're preparing for an exam, certification, interview, or presentation, Kuliko keeps your subjects, study materials, learning resources, and progress organized in one library. Upload a document or bring the notes already in your conversation, then turn them into a focused study session.

Finding an answer isn't the same as being ready. Study with Kuliko and stay ready.

defaultPrompt: I want to review my flashcards on inflation
Let's take a quiz on inflation
Show me my inflation notes mind map
